app.name: Tideline
app.tagline: Operator software for ferry, crew-boat and charter owners. Calm, precise and built for the water.

hero.title: Every voyage, on record.
hero.body: Operator software for ferry, crew-boat and charter owners. Calm, precise and built for the water.

modes.title: Two modes, one record.
modes.body: Turn on what your business runs. Vessels, crew, documents and payments are shared underneath.

ferry.label: Ferry mode
ferry.title: For passenger boat operators
items: Tickets online, at the jetty or by transfer
Live tracking from the captain’s phone
Daily takings, cash and digital, per boat

charter.label: Charter mode
charter.title: For crew-boat and offshore vessel owners
items: Certificate expiry alerts before they bite
Tender packs drafted from your own documents
Quotes, contracts and invoices in one thread
Escrow so both sides know the money is there

safety.title: A safety check before every departure.
safety.body: Rules decide, in plain words. A blocked trip can only leave with the owner’s logged approval — and an overloaded boat can’t leave at all.

checks.title: Weather
checks.body: Wind, gusts, waves and rain along the route, against limits you can only make stricter.

checks.title: Daylight
checks.body: Departure and arrival checked against sunrise and sunset at the jetty.

checks.title: Capacity
checks.body: Passengers counted against seats, life jackets confirmed. No override.

checks.title: Documents
checks.body: Vessel licence and captain’s competency must be in date.

field.title: Built for the water, not the office.

items.title: Works offline
items.body: Trips, manifests and safety checks save on the phone and sync when the signal comes back.

items.title: WhatsApp first
items.body: Log a trip with a voice note. Alerts, approvals and invoices arrive where your team already is.

items.title: Any phone
items.body: Light enough for a low-cost Android on a slow network, readable in full sun.

cta.title: Run your fleet by the tide.
cta.body: We’re onboarding our first ferry and crew-boat operators now.
